title: Galaxy Rush
description: Bolt pods onto a ridiculous spaceship, feed its Heart to level it up, and jetpack through three regions of space weirdos to take down Big Gerald. Merge matching pods into MEGA pods, crank up the Heat, and bring up to four friends in online co-op.
